title.note: Game title kept byte-identical (glossary keep); Brazilian players know Roblox games by their English titles.

hud.reel.note: Pull the line in, the word a Brazilian kid shouts when a fish bites; same verb in the pass Auto Puxar. 'Recolher' (8) is the more technical option.

hud.bait_left.note: Label form so count = 0 or 1 stays correct.

catch.success.note: Rarity is masculine (Raro, Mítico) and agrees with masculine 'peixe'; the fish name goes after a colon so feminine names (Carpa Dourada, Enguia-Lanterna) need no agreement. Rarity shows capitalized mid-sentence as a tier name.

catch.escaped.note: 'It' named as the generic 'o peixe' so the toast reads clearly on its own.

catch.new_record.note: For the developer: {weight} arrives as 12.4; Brazil writes 12,4 with a decimal comma. Fix in game code, not here.

fish.lantern_eel.note: Hyphenated like real Portuguese species names (peixe-lanterna, peixe-boi); keeps the glowing-lantern idea. Item-name capitalization.

rarity.mythic.note: Masculine tier form, above Lendário, as the guide's rarity list does.

shop.rods.note: Fishing rods; 'Varas de pesca' (14) is over the 10 budget and the fishing shop makes the sense clear.

shop.equipped.note: State label agreeing with 'vara' (feminine). If this label is ever reused on non-rod items, use 'Em uso' instead.

pass.auto_reel.note: Same verb as hud.reel; 'Auto' + verb follows Brazilian gamer usage (auto farm, auto clicker). Fully Portuguese 'Puxada Automática' is 17, over the 14 budget. Creator Hub pass name should match.
pass.auto_reel.blind_remark: English-style word order; reads like a calque rather than a natural Portuguese product name

pass.lucky_bait.text: A Isca da Sorte dobra sua chance de pescar peixes raros!
pass.lucky_bait.note: Article 'A' added outside the bold tag because Portuguese puts one before a named subject; 'pescar' added so 'chance of rare fish' reads naturally.

sell.done.note: Label form because count and coins can be 1 ('1 peixes', '1 moedas' would break). Less spoken than a normal toast.

sell.prompt.note: 'Pressione E para vender' (23) is Roblox's verb but over 21. For the developer: phone and console players have no E key; ActionText 'Vender' alone would serve everyone.

ascend.button.note: Infinitive button like Roblox pt-BR UI; plain verb, no religious sense. Same word in ascend.confirm. A native should confirm it reads as a prestige action to kids.
ascend.button.blind_remark: fairly formal, uncommon verb in everyday Brazilian Portuguese; sounds identical to 'acender' (to light)

ascend.confirm.text: Ascender agora? Você recomeça do zero, mas pesca peixes raros com {bonus}% mais frequência.
ascend.confirm.note: Present tense in both clauses instead of future, per the guide; 'start over' as 'recomeça do zero'.

weather.storm.text: Tempestade chegando! Peixes raros estão mordendo a isca.
weather.storm.note: 'biting' as 'mordendo a isca' so it can't read as biting people; 'Uma tempestade está chegando!' would push it past 60.

quest.catch_n.note: Count moved to the end as a label because n can be 1 ('Pesque 1 peixes' breaks).
quest.catch_n.review_reason: The trailing ': {n}' reads like a stiff form field and leaves it unclear whether the number is the goal or the progress so far; the number right after the verb keeps it as the target, and 'pescar' already implies fish, so it stays correct for n = 1.

friends.boost.text: Pescar com amigos dá +{percent}% de sorte

trade.accept.note: 'your trade' made explicit as the request, matching trade.sent; past-tense verb has no gender.

codes.redeemed.note: Possessive dropped where obvious, as Portuguese does.

afk.kicked.text: Você ficou AFK por muito tempo e parou de pescar.
afk.kicked.note: 'idle' as AFK (kept in English per the guide) because 'parado'/'inativo' would assume a male player.

event.ends.note: For the developer: '2d 4h' reads fine in pt-BR, but minutes should show as 'min', not 'm', if the game ever formats them.

daily.streak.text: Sequência: dia {day}! Volte amanhã para ganhar mais.
daily.streak.note: Label form because day can be 1 ('Sequência de 1 dias' breaks). '{day}º dia seguido' is more natural but the ordinal sign trips lint.

tip.night.text: Dica: alguns peixes só mordem a isca à noite.
tip.night.note: 'bite' as 'mordem a isca', same fishing sense as weather.storm.

group.join.text: Entre na nossa comunidade e ganhe 50 iscas grátis!
group.join.note: Roblox renamed groups to 'Comunidades' in pt-BR; 'nossa' tells players which community, as the guide's reference does.

leaderboard.biggest.note: Heaviest by weight; 'Maior peixe' could read as longest.
